_about: Every thing the game draws today, described for an image model: what it is, its real size, what the game needs of it, and how each style's concept sheets draw it. Sizes are from the kits' specs (city/tools/styles/*/specs) and the catalogue (city/catalogue/catalogue.json). A missing style under 'looks' means the sheets do not show the thing closely. The 'story' lines are proposals for the owner to edit. Written 2026-10-02; tools/build_jobs.py reads this file. Revised on 2026-10-02 after the pilot batch and a check of every description against the sheets.

great-tree.name: the great tree
great-tree.what: The great tree at the centre of the tree square: one large living shade tree, about 12 m across and 9.5 m tall, with a thick buttressed trunk that forks low into heavy spreading limbs. It stands in a raised bed 5.2 m square whose low edge people sit on.
great-tree.rules: Outside the 5.2 m bed nothing hangs lower than 2.2 m, because people walk under the crown. The crown is wide and fairly flat on top. A few small lanterns hang from the limbs. The crown is one closed mass of large, solid, rounded leaf clumps: full all round and on top, with no gaps through which the sky or the branches show, and no single leaves or twigs.
great-tree.story: It is older than every building round it, and the square was laid out to keep it. The lanterns were hung by the guild's makers.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A broad shade tree with a forked warm-brown trunk and a crown of faceted leaf clumps, olive in shade and yellow-green in light, with a few pale blossoms; a stone-edged bed full of broad-leaved plants and flowers; yellow lanterns.
looks.voxel: A trunk of brown cubes two to three cubes wide and a large rounded crown of green cubes in three tones, a few set proud; a grey block bed with cube shrubs.
looks.anime_cel: A tall broad tree with a grey-brown forked trunk and a lush crown of large solid leaf clumps, closed all round and on top, yellow-green in light and deep green in shade; no aerial roots; the sheets draw the trunk rising straight from the paving, so keep the game's bed a low plain stone kerb.
looks.solarpunk: A massive spreading tree with a pale brown trunk, a few aerial roots and an olive and khaki crown; ringed by cream stone seat-planters and timber planter boxes with flowers.
looks.neon_noir: A broad dark-leaved tree with a thick trunk and clusters of violet flowers; strings of small warm lights through the crown and a few hanging lanterns; a dark concrete bed edge with a warm light strip under its rim.
looks.pixel_art: A large tree with a thick brown trunk and a clustered crown, bright yellow-green leaf highlights over dark teal-green shadow; a stone block bed with flowers.

guild-hall.name: the guild hall
guild-hall.what: The guild hall, the makers' workshop: a low rectangular hall under three sawtooth roof bays, each about 4.3 m wide, with walls 5.2 m high and roof ridges about 8 m high. Its front is made of panels 4 m wide: solid wall, glazed wall, and one door panel with double doors 2 m wide and 3.2 m high, between square corner piers. Workbenches show through the glazing.
guild-hall.rules: Keep three equal sawtooth bays on a low, long hall. Leave a plain band above the door for the game's own sign.
guild-hall.story: The guild built it for itself. The north-light roof was drawn first, and each bay was put up by a different crew, so the bays match without being identical.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: Terracotta sawtooth roofs on a bright orange-brown timber frame with dark glazing bars, tall glazed fronts showing a warm interior, jackfruit-yellow awnings at ground level.
looks.voxel: A bright yellow cube hall with yellow sawtooth roofs whose upright faces are grey skylights, a grey stone base, one wide glazed opening.
looks.anime_cel: A red-brick hall with red-brown sawtooth roofs, each slope carrying one long blue-grey skylight, and tall windows in dark slim steel frames.
looks.solarpunk: Blonde timber-slat walls, sawtooth roofs covered in blue solar panels, climbing plants between the bays, warm glazed fronts.
looks.neon_noir: A dark steel-framed hall with dark navy sawtooth roofs and tall glazing that glows amber.
looks.pixel_art: A red brick hall with dark slate sawtooth roofs and rows of yellow-lit windows.

library.name: the library
library.what: The library: a broad two-storey building with a rounded reading-room roof about 9 m across. Its walls are bays 2 m wide and 8 m high with tall openings and slim columns; the entrance is 3.2 m wide with double doors; two hanging banners about 1.2 m by 4.3 m flank it.
library.rules: Broad and calm, lower than the towers behind it. The banners carry one simple book or leaf emblem.
library.story: The reading room came first and the wings were added as the collection grew. The banners are changed with the seasons.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: Cream limewash walls with tall arched windows, a green copper dome over the reading room, jackfruit-yellow banners.
looks.voxel: An orange barrel-vaulted hall of cubes with a white end arch and a cobalt-blue glazed entrance.
looks.anime_cel: A silver barrel-vault roof over a tall glazed arched front that glows warm, on a pale stone base with slim mullions.
looks.solarpunk: A round cream ceramic drum with a ring of glazing, a blue solar-glass dome, a planted roof ring and brass trim.
looks.neon_noir: A pale round drum with a dark blue glass dome, an amber light ring under the dome and a glazed ground floor glowing warm.
looks.pixel_art: A cream stone drum under a dark slate-blue dome, blue banners with a white emblem, a lit entrance.

cafe.name: the café
cafe.what: The café: a small single-storey building about 4 m high behind an open terrace, with a wide serving opening or double doors 2 m wide and a deep awning, and room in front for round tables and umbrellas.
cafe.rules: One storey. Leave a plain band above the opening for the game's own sign.
cafe.story: Two guild members opened it so that there would be somewhere to argue about drawings. The terrace is older than the building.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A cream stone arcade with round arches, pink-flowering climbers and black iron wall lanterns, under a terracotta roof, with a jackfruit-yellow awning.
looks.solarpunk: Cream ceramic walls, a timber-slat canopy and a planted roof.

tram.name: the tram
tram.what: The boulevard tram: a low-floor tram 20.5 m long, 2.5 m wide and about 3.5 m high to the roof, with a pantograph above, in three to five jointed sections, with wide doors on both sides, a long band of windows and a driver's cab at each end.
tram.rules: A cream or white body with one coral-red stripe along its length, in every style. Windows are dark by day. It runs on rails set flush in the ground.
tram.story: It is the line's first tram and still in service. The stripe is repainted by hand every year.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A cream body with a coral-red stripe and a dark window band, softly rounded ends.
looks.voxel: A white tram of cubes with an orange-red stripe and dark square windows.
looks.anime_cel: A modern cream tram with two coral-red bands, at the roofline and below the windows, navy doors, dark windows and thin ink lines.
looks.solarpunk: A long white tram with a red stripe, black door frames and a slim roof.
looks.neon_noir: A white and silver tram with a red lower band; its windows are shown lit amber.
looks.pixel_art: A red and cream tram with rows of windows.

tram-shelter.name: the tram shelter
tram-shelter.what: The tram shelter: a canopy about 4.5 m long, 2 m deep and 2.9 m high on slim posts, with a back screen, a bench inside, and one tall sign panel at one end.
tram-shelter.rules: Open at the front, towards the track. The sign panel is blank: the game draws its content.
tram-shelter.story: Each stop's shelter was made in the guild hall and carried out in pieces. The bench inside is the same as the park benches.

looks.anime_cel: A long dark steel and glass shelter with a flat roof.
looks.solarpunk: A slim canopy with a blue solar roof on dark slim steel posts, with glass screens.
looks.pixel_art: A dark steel shelter with a lit strip under its roof.

houses.name: the town houses
houses.what: Town houses for the city blocks: three variants of one house about 6.6 m wide, 8.2 m high and 9 m deep, two to three storeys, each with a ground-floor door, regular windows and a simple roof.
houses.rules: Three separate buildings, alike in size and materials and different in roof, window rhythm and colour accent.
houses.story: Their first occupants built them from one kit of parts, which is why they rhyme without matching.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: Cream walls, terracotta hip roofs, plain dark-teal window panes.
looks.voxel: Cube houses in cream and blue with flat parapet roofs, roof gardens and blue roof panels.
looks.anime_cel: Rendered walls from white to pale grey, one of them tan, with grey flat roofs and planting.
looks.solarpunk: Cream walls with timber balconies, planted roofs and solar panels.
looks.neon_noir: Grey walls with a few lit windows under dark navy flat roofs; no neon (the neon lines are on the towers).
looks.pixel_art: Sand and brick walls with flat roofs carrying plants.

shop.name: the shop
shop.what: A shop building about 5 m wide, 8.5 m high and 9 m deep: a glazed shopfront with a door and a deep awning at street level, and one or two plain storeys above.
shop.rules: Leave a plain band above the awning for the game's own sign.
shop.story: It has changed trades three times and kept the same awning frame.

towers.name: the downtown towers
towers.what: Downtown towers: two variants of a stepped tower about 11 to 14 m square and 25 to 29 m high, eight or nine storeys, stepping back twice towards the top, with planted terraces on the steps and a small roof structure.
towers.rules: Two separate towers, alike in materials and different in how they step. Regular window rows.
towers.story: The first tall buildings in the city, built with terraces so that nobody would live without a garden.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: Cream towers with regular dark windows and flat roofs carrying a small gold finial or a few roof plants.
looks.voxel: White and cobalt-glass cube towers with green roof gardens and an orange base course.
looks.anime_cel: Pale concrete and blue glass, stepping back with planted terraces.
looks.solarpunk: Cream rounded towers with deep planted terraces and solar roofs.
looks.neon_noir: Dark towers with warm lit windows, planted terraces and thin magenta lines of light on their edges.
looks.pixel_art: Beige and blue-glass towers with plants on the roofs.

bridge.name: the north bridge
bridge.what: The north bridge: one low stone bridge of three equal spans, each about 8 m long on piers about 1.5 m thick, with a deck about 4.3 m wide between railings, and beside it a length of quay wall about 2.5 m high.
bridge.rules: Low and level. No towers taller than a lamp post and no cables.
bridge.story: The oldest structure after the tree. Its middle pier still carries the mark of the highest flood.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: Cream stone arches with small turrets on the piers.
looks.voxel: Grey stone cubes with a flat deck and block piers.
looks.anime_cel: Cream stone arches (#EFCFB5) with a dark iron railing and lamp posts on the deck.
looks.solarpunk: Cream stone arches with plain parapets.
looks.neon_noir: A pale low arch bridge with a line of warm lights along the deck.
looks.pixel_art: Grey stone arches with a pale stone parapet between stone posts, and black lamp posts.

fountain.name: the fountain
fountain.what: The square's fountain: a round basin 3 m across with a rim 45 cm high and broad enough to sit on, and a centre piece about 1.9 m high from which water falls into the basin.
fountain.rules: People sit on the rim facing out, so the rim is flat and plain.
fountain.story: A gift from the first makers to pass their trial. They signed it under the rim, where nobody looks.

resident.name: a resident
resident.what: A resident of the city: an adult about 1.8 m tall in contemporary everyday clothes for a warm climate.
resident.rules: Standing relaxed with the arms slightly away from the body. A shirt or top, trousers or a skirt, shoes. No lettering on clothes.
resident.story: One of the people who live and work here. Nobody in the city is background.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: Faceted hair and clothes, a smoothly shaded face; green, yellow, white and terracotta clothes; a straw sun hat.
looks.voxel: A square head, cube hair, simple dot eyes; blue, orange and green clothes.
looks.anime_cel: An anime character in summer clothes with thin ink outlines.
looks.solarpunk: Loose linen and cotton in natural colours, a canvas backpack.
looks.neon_noir: A dark jacket and a scarf, softly lit.
looks.pixel_art: A small pixel character with a clear silhouette.

agent-a1.name: City Agent A1
agent-a1.what: City Agent A1, the city's recurring agent, between 1.65 and 1.8 m tall.
agent-a1.rules: Standing relaxed with the arms slightly away from the body. A leaf badge on the chest and no lettering.
agent-a1.story: The agent people ask first. It has looked the same since the city opened, so that anyone can find it.

bench.name: park bench
bench.what: A park bench for two: 1.6 m long, 0.6 m deep, seat 45 cm high, back to 85 cm.
bench.story: Made in the guild hall. The seat boards are worn paler where people sit, and there is a small blank maker's plate on the back rail.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: Chunky warm-brown timber: two broad seat boards, two broad back planks, timber arm blocks, dark posts.
looks.voxel: Orange-brown timber cubes between block ends, with a low cube back.
looks.anime_cel: Broad timber planks on near-black iron ends, each end one flat bar bent into leg, arm and back post.
looks.solarpunk: All timber: slats between solid timber ends under a timber arm, with a thick top rail.
looks.neon_noir: Dark timber slats on dark metal with a short warm light bar under the back rail.
looks.pixel_art: Three back planks, the top one with a lit edge, and three seat planks on a dark frame.

cafe-chair.name: café chair
cafe-chair.what: A café chair: 46 cm wide, 50 cm deep, seat 45 cm high, back to 90 cm.

reading-chair.name: reading chair
reading-chair.what: A reading armchair: 85 cm wide and deep, 95 cm high, low and upholstered.
reading-chair.story: From the library's reading room. The left arm is worn smoother than the right.

perch-seat.name: perch seat
perch-seat.what: A perch seat: a plain seat stone 30 cm by 55 cm and 46 cm high with a timber board on top. The game draws one at every place someone can sit on a wall, a step or inside a shelter, so it usually stands in or against the thing it belongs to.
perch-seat.story: Cut from the offcuts of the benches.
perch-seat.rules: A plain block with a seat board. Not a stool: no legs, no frame, no back.

cafe-table.name: café table
cafe-table.what: A round café table: 80 cm across and 75 cm high, on one central leg or three legs.
cafe-table.story: Its top has been planed back twice.

umbrella.name: café umbrella
umbrella.what: A café umbrella: canopy 2.3 m across, 2.5 m high, the canopy's edge above head height at 2.2 m, on a pole with a weighted base.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A jackfruit-yellow canopy in eight flat panels.
looks.solarpunk: A cream-white canvas canopy on a pale timber pole.

planter.name: square planter
planter.what: A square planter box: 1.3 m square and 45 cm high, planted full. Its plants stay inside the box's edges.
planter.story: Each is looked after by whoever works nearest to it, so no two are planted alike.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A pale stone box brimming with broad-leaved plants and yellow and pink blossoms.
looks.voxel: A grey cube box under a heap of small green cubes with white blossom cubes.
looks.anime_cel: A low grey concrete trough with loose leafy shrubs.
looks.solarpunk: A cream stone box planted with a flowering shrub.
looks.neon_noir: A dark concrete box with a warm light strip at its foot and dark planting with violet flowers.
looks.pixel_art: A brown brick box full of flowering plants.

planter-pot.name: planter pot
planter-pot.what: A round planter pot: 80 cm across and about 1.1 m high with its plant.
planter-pot.story: Moved about by the café to mark out its terrace.

lamp-post.name: street lamp
lamp-post.what: A street lamp: 4.2 m high, one lantern at about 3.5 m on a slim post with a small base.
lamp-post.story: Cast in one batch for the square. The lantern glass has been replaced more than once, so no two are quite the same colour.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A black iron post with a square lantern head and a small yellow banner on an arm.
looks.voxel: A black cube post with a lantern cube that glows warm.
looks.anime_cel: A classic black post with a single lantern.
looks.solarpunk: A slim dark post with a brass-capped glass lantern.
looks.neon_noir: A slim dark post with a tapered glass lantern that glows warm.
looks.pixel_art: A black iron post with an amber lantern.

bollard.name: bollard
bollard.what: A bollard: 90 cm high and 24 cm across.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A plain dark iron post with a rounded or chamfered cap.

catenary-pole.name: catenary pole
catenary-pole.what: A catenary pole for the tram's overhead wire: 6 m high, slim, with one side arm near the top.
catenary-pole.story: Painted the same colour as the lamp posts so that it disappears.

railing.name: railing
railing.what: A railing panel: 2 m long and 1.1 m high, with an end post.
railing.story: The top rail is polished by hands along the waterfront.

looks.pixel_art: Dark iron bars between stone posts.

noticeboard.name: noticeboard
noticeboard.what: A noticeboard: 1.5 m wide and 2.5 m high, on two posts under a small roof, with a board 1.1 m by 0.8 m.
noticeboard.rules: The board is blank: the game draws the notices.
noticeboard.story: The city pins its notices here, and so does everybody else.

plaque.name: plaque
plaque.what: A plaque on a low plinth: 60 cm wide and 1.2 m high, with a sloping face.
plaque.rules: The face is blank: the game draws its lettering.
plaque.story: One stands wherever something was first tried.

kiosk.name: kiosk
kiosk.what: An information kiosk: a standing slab 80 cm wide, 1.9 m high and 50 cm deep, with a screen 60 cm by 80 cm at chest height.
kiosk.rules: The screen is blank: the game draws its content.
kiosk.story: It answers the same three questions all day: what is here, when is it free, and whom to ask.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A grey rounded stone-like slab with a pale screen face.
looks.voxel: A white and grey cube console with a tilted screen.
looks.anime_cel: A slim dark totem with a glass screen.
looks.solarpunk: A cream ceramic pod with a brass-framed screen.
looks.neon_noir: A dark monolith with a blue glass screen.
looks.pixel_art: A dark navy monolith with a blue screen.

steps-and-wall.name: steps and low wall
steps-and-wall.what: Broad steps 3 m wide, 1 m deep and 45 cm high in three risers, and beside them a low sitting wall 3 m long, 30 cm thick and 45 cm high.
steps-and-wall.story: Where people wait for the tram when the benches are full.

desk.name: desk with stool
desk.what: A workshop desk with a stool: the desk 1.3 m wide, 70 cm deep and 75 cm high.
desk.story: Every maker has one. The tops are swapped when they are too scarred to draw on.

workstation.name: workstation
workstation.what: A workstation: the same desk carrying a computer with one screen.
workstation.rules: The screen is blank: the game draws its content.
workstation.story: Shared, and booked by the hour.

workbench.name: workbench
workbench.what: A long workbench: 3.2 m long, 1 m deep and 90 cm high, with a heavy top and a lower shelf.
workbench.story: The oldest thing in the hall. Its top is a record of every job that slipped.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.what: A bookshelf: 2 m wide, 2.6 m high and 45 cm deep, with five shelves of books.
bookshelf.rules: Book spines are plain colours with no lettering.
bookshelf.story: Filled by donation, so the spines never match.

pegboard.name: pegboard
pegboard.what: A pegboard wall panel 2 m wide and 1.2 m high with hand tools hung in rows.
pegboard.story: Every tool has a painted outline behind it, so a missing one shows.

pendant-lamp.name: pendant lamp
pendant-lamp.what: A pendant lamp: a metal shade about 45 cm across hanging on a cord.
pendant-lamp.story: Hung low over each bench by whoever works there.

street-tree-a.name: street tree
street-tree-a.what: A street tree: crown 4.6 m across, 5.5 m tall, with a clear trunk to 2.2 m.
street-tree-a.story: Planted the year the tram line opened.
street-tree-a.rules: The crown is a closed, rounded mass of solid leaf clumps, full on top and all round.

street-tree-b.name: small street tree
street-tree-b.what: A smaller street tree: crown 3.4 m across, 4.4 m tall, with a clear trunk to 2.2 m.
street-tree-b.story: A replacement, still catching up with its neighbours.
street-tree-b.rules: The crown is a closed, rounded mass of solid leaf clumps, full on top and all round.

palm-tall.name: tall palm
palm-tall.what: A tall palm: 8.5 m high, fronds 5.2 m across, on a slender ringed trunk with a slight lean.
palm-tall.story: They mark the river's edge from anywhere in the city.

palm-short.name: short palm
palm-short.what: A short palm: 4.5 m high, fronds 3.4 m across.
palm-short.story: Grown from the tall palms' seed.

shrub-round.name: round shrub
shrub-round.what: A round clipped shrub: 1.1 m across and 0.9 m high.
shrub-round.story: Clipped by the same hand for years.

shrub-leafy.name: leafy shrub
shrub-leafy.what: A loose leafy shrub: 1.1 m across and 1.2 m high.
shrub-leafy.story: Left to grow as it likes.

flowerbed.name: flowerbed
flowerbed.what: A kerbed flowerbed: 3 m long, 1 m wide and about 60 cm high with its flowers.
flowerbed.story: Replanted each season by the school.

meadow.name: meadow clumps
meadow.what: Two meadow clumps side by side: a tuft of tall grass, and a tuft of grass with flowers, each about 30 cm across and 90 cm high.
meadow.story: Sown along the river where nothing else was planned.

sailboat.name: sailing boat
sailboat.what: A small sailing boat: hull about 5 m long, mast 6.8 m, with one or two sails.
sailboat.story: Built in the guild hall one winter and launched from the quay.

looks.lowpoly_tropical: A white triangular sail with one yellow panel over a red or brown hull.
looks.solarpunk: A white sail over a pale hull.

cloud-a.name: cloud
cloud-a.what: A cloud about 10 m long with a flat base.

looks.pixel_art: A pixel cloud in white and pale pink.

cloud-b.name: small cloud
cloud-b.what: A smaller cloud about 8 m long with a flat base.
